title: Twilio Account auth token: one-property twin (context)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context:field: the Auth Token column relabelled Account SID; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context) and context:keyword: the 'twilio auth_token=' gate replaced by 'cache etag='; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context). Twin of "Twilio Account auth token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of twilio-auth-token-profiles-auth-token: context:field: the Auth Token column relabelled Account SID; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context). The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
